title: Add 7/14/30d aggregated usage windows to analytics pipeline
author: Mei Lin
description: Context: The PLG→sales signal routing work needs stable aggregation windows (7/14/30d) for spend, tokens, concurrency, and error/rate-limit friction to avoid per-event scanning in the scoring service. This PR adds daily-refreshed rollups and exposes a single “windowed usage” view for downstream consumers. Summary: (1) Adds new aggregate tables for 7/14/30-day windows keyed by account_id + day; (2) Updates the dbt models / warehouse transforms to compute windowed metrics (spend_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, requests, peak_concurrency_est, errors_5xx, rate_limited_429); (3) Adds a backfill job (last 120 days) with guardrails to avoid warehouse overload; (4) Adds validation queries to compare rollups vs raw events and catch drift; (5) Documents refresh cadence + known limitations. Refresh cadence: Daily partition rebuild for D-1, and incremental window recompute for the last 30 days. Backfill: One-time job intended to run in prod after deploy (see runbook notes below). Risks/notes: Concurrency is estimated from per-minute request buckets (not true in-flight). We keep both avg_rps and peak_rps to better approximate burstiness. Rate-limit 429s sourced from gateway logs; note that some SDK retries can inflate counts. Rollout plan: Merge → deploy to analytics pipeline → run backfill in off-peak hours → verify with included validation queries → notify signal-scoring owners. Links: ENG-2841. Testing: Ran dbt build for affected models and executed validation queries on staging (see CI output).
commits: warehouse: add daily request buckets and 429/5xx rollups
jobs: add backfill_rolling_usage_windows with rate limiting + checkpoints
docs: add validation queries + refresh cadence notes
illustrative_snippet: Example output columns (windowed_usage_30d): account_id, window_end_day, spend_usd_30d, requests_30d, input_tokens_30d, output_tokens_30d, rate_limited_429_30d, errors_5xx_30d, avg_rps_30d, peak_rps_30d, peak_concurrency_est_30d, model_routing_failures_30d (nullable).
review_conversation: Nadia Rahman: Can you clarify how peak_concurrency_est is computed? Worried we’ll interpret it as true in-flight concurrency and set thresholds too aggressively. Mei Lin: Good call. It’s derived from per-minute request buckets using (requests_per_minute * p95_duration_seconds / 60) and then taking the max over the window. I’ll (a) rename the field to peak_concurrency_est_* and (b) add a comment in the model docs. Nadia Rahman: 👍 Please also include avg_rps and peak_rps so scoring can use burstiness directly. Mei Lin: Added avg_rps_* and peak_rps_* for each window and updated schema.yml docs. Logan Wright: Backfill job looks fine, but we need safeguards for warehouse load + a way to resume. Can we add checkpoints per-day and a max partitions per run? Mei Lin: Added checkpointing keyed by day partition; default max_partitions_per_run=14; also added --dry-run and --start-day/--end-day flags. Caleb Johnson: For errors_5xx, are we counting gateway 5xx only or also upstream runtime failures? If it’s gateway-only we may miss runtime timeouts. Mei Lin: Currently gateway-only because it’s consistent across deployment modes. I added a TODO and column placeholder for runtime_error_rollups once those are standardized; also documented the limitation in analytics/README.md. Allison Grant: Validation queries are helpful. Please add one check that the 7d metrics are monotonically <= 14d <= 30d for a sample set (sanity). Mei Lin: Added a monotonicity check query and wired it into the staging validation runbook section. Logan Wright: One more: please ensure we’re not storing per-user identifiers anywhere in these rollups. Mei Lin: Confirmed—keys are account_id + day; no user_id/email, and only aggregated counts/sums. Added a note in README.
requested_changes: Rename peak_concurrency_* fields to peak_concurrency_est_* and document computation
Add checkpointing/resume + max partitions per run for backfill job
Add monotonicity sanity check across windows
release_notes: Analytics: Added 7/14/30-day aggregated usage windows (spend, tokens, requests, 429/5xx, burst metrics) for downstream PLG signal scoring. Includes backfill job and validation queries.
